description: This file defines the ServiceMcaRule class, which models a mail condition/action rule within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes parsing XML configuration, evaluating conditions, and executing actions based on email message attributes.

classes.name: ServiceMcaRule
classes.description: Represents a mail condition/action rule with methods for parsing XML, evaluating conditions, and executing actions.

methods.name: ServiceMcaRule
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule from an XML element, parsing conditions and actions.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the rule's conditions and executes associated actions if conditions are met.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the rule is enabled.
